result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major missing/broken image in the 'Popular right now' section and a minor layout truncation of a restaurant card name in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken-image placeholder icon (gray box with a crossed-out picture symbol) instead of an actual restaurant photo, despite having a '€0 delivery' badge and favorite button overlaid on it.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image asset for this restaurant card, or provide a proper fallback (e.g., branded placeholder or gradient with logo) instead of the raw broken-image glyph.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right screen edge with no visible affordance that more content is scrollable, which can look like clipped/broken text.
issues.suggestion: Add a scroll hint (partial card peek with padding, fade edge, or horizontal scroll indicator) and ensure card titles ellipsize gracefully within their container.
